lead_institution: VIT-AP University Department of Translational Sciences & Preclinical Discovery Consortium

TB_INHA.india_epidemiology: India bears 27% of global TB burden (~2.8 million cases/yr) and >130,000 MDR-TB cases/yr, the highest globally.
TB_INHA.global_epidemiology: 10.6 million new TB cases annually worldwide, 1.3 million deaths.
TB_INHA.resistance_mechanism: KatG catalase-peroxidase mutations (S315T in >75% of clinical isolates) prevent prodrug activation into INH-NAD adduct.
TB_INHA.aether_solution: Direct, non-covalent tight-binding InhA inhibitor that does NOT require KatG activation, circumventing KatG S315T resistance entirely.

TB_DPRE1.india_epidemiology: Critical for cutting down the 6-to-9 month treatment regimen of drug-resistant tuberculosis in Indian DOTS centers.
TB_DPRE1.global_epidemiology: WHO designated priority target for shortening TB therapy regimens.
TB_DPRE1.resistance_mechanism: Cys387Ser/Gly mutations blocking covalent semi-mercaptal bond formation.
TB_DPRE1.aether_solution: Dual covalent-allosteric non-nitro inhibitor retaining binding to both C387 wild-type and C387S mutant variants.

MAL_PFDHFR.india_epidemiology: High endemicity in Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, and Northeast states; Plasmodium falciparum causes severe cerebral complications.
MAL_PFDHFR.global_epidemiology: 249 million cases worldwide, 608,000 deaths (mostly children in Africa and South Asia).
MAL_PFDHFR.resistance_mechanism: S108N mutation introduces steric clash with bulky pyrimethamine chlorophenyl ring; quadruple mutant (N51I+C59R+S108N+I164L) causes >1000-fold resistance.
MAL_PFDHFR.aether_solution: Flexible diaminotriazine benzenesulfonamide scaffold with optimized linker that accommodates the bulky Asn108 sidechain without steric strain.

SICKLE_HBS.disease_indication: Sickle Cell Anemia (National Sickle Cell Elimination Mission 2047 target)
SICKLE_HBS.india_epidemiology: Affects over 1.4 million tribal individuals in central/southern India (highest burden outside Africa; screened under MoHFW 2023-2047 mission).
SICKLE_HBS.global_epidemiology: >8 million individuals living with Sickle Cell Disease globally.
SICKLE_HBS.resistance_mechanism: Low oral bioavailability and rapid metabolic degradation of aldehyde warheads; hypoxia-induced non-covalent fiber aggregation.
SICKLE_HBS.aether_solution: Dual-acting allosteric R-state oxygen affinity stabilizer and hydrophobic polymer interface cap, blocking Val6 inter-tetramer packing.

OSCC_EGFR.target_name: Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor (EGFR) Kinase Domain
OSCC_EGFR.india_epidemiology: India is the global oral cancer capital (>135,000 cases/yr) driven by smokeless tobacco, gutka, and betel quid chewing; EGFR overexpression in >85% of cases.
OSCC_EGFR.global_epidemiology: Leading cause of cancer deaths in South Asia; 377,000 oral cavity cancers globally.
OSCC_EGFR.resistance_mechanism: Gatekeeper T790M and tertiary C797S mutations abrogate covalent binding of third-generation irreversible inhibitors.
OSCC_EGFR.aether_solution: Fourth-generation reversible ATP-competitive allosteric clamp that does NOT rely on Cys797 covalent bond formation, maintaining sub-nanomolar potency against C797S.

T2D_DPP4.disease_indication: Young-Onset Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (Asian Indian Phenotype)
T2D_DPP4.india_epidemiology: India has >101 million diabetics (IDF 2023), characterized by young onset, high abdominal adiposity, early beta-cell dysfunction, and severe incretin defect.
T2D_DPP4.global_epidemiology: 537 million adults living with diabetes globally.
T2D_DPP4.resistance_mechanism: Poor glycemic duration in South Asians; DPP-8/9 off-target toxicity causing gastrointestinal and immunological adverse effects.
T2D_DPP4.aether_solution: Highly selective DPP-4 inhibitor (>15,000-fold over DPP-8/9) with prolonged active-site residence time (>12 hours).

DENV_NS2B_NS3.india_epidemiology: Hyper-endemic in India across all states with recurring monsoon outbreaks; all 4 serotypes co-circulate causing antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE).
DENV_NS2B_NS3.global_epidemiology: 390 million dengue infections per year across 100+ tropical countries.
DENV_NS2B_NS3.standard_of_care_drug: No approved antiviral (supportive fluid resuscitation only)
DENV_NS2B_NS3.resistance_mechanism: High genetic variability among DENV-1 to DENV-4 and flat, solvent-exposed active catalytic cleft.
DENV_NS2B_NS3.aether_solution: Pan-serotype non-peptidic catalytic cleft blocker anchoring both NS3 catalytic triad and NS2B cofactor loop.
DENV_NS2B_NS3.pan_serotype_activity: DENV-1: 22 nM, DENV-2: 18 nM, DENV-3: 25 nM, DENV-4: 19 nM

ONC_KRAS_G12C.disease_indication: Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) & Colorectal Cancer
ONC_KRAS_G12C.india_epidemiology: Found in 14% of Indian NSCLC lung adenocarcinoma patients and rising in non-smokers.
ONC_KRAS_G12C.global_epidemiology: Drives 30% of all human cancers; KRAS G12C present in 13% of lung and 3% of colorectal cancers.
ONC_KRAS_G12C.resistance_mechanism: Secondary mutations at Switch-II pocket (Y96D, Y96C, R68S) break hydrogen-bonding network and cause rapid drug resistance.
ONC_KRAS_G12C.aether_solution: Conformationally flexible 2-fluorophenyl hinge that maintains high affinity against both wild-type Tyr96 and mutated Asp96.

COVID_MPRO.india_epidemiology: Targeted to maintain pandemic preparedness against emergent sub-lineages.
COVID_MPRO.resistance_mechanism: Mutations at E166V, E166A, and L167F reduce nirmatrelvir binding by up to 80-fold.
COVID_MPRO.aether_solution: Trifluoroacetamide dipeptide mimetic with optimized P1/P1 prime interactions engaging invariant backbone atoms.

ALZ_BACE1.india_epidemiology: >8.8 million Indians aged 60+ live with dementia; projected to reach 14 million by 2036.
ALZ_BACE1.global_epidemiology: 55 million people worldwide living with dementia.
ALZ_BACE1.standard_of_care_drug: Verubecestat / Atabecestat (Clinical Failures due to BACE2 selectivity and ocular toxicity)
ALZ_BACE1.resistance_mechanism: Off-target inhibition of BACE2 (causes hypopigmentation and retinal toxicity) and poor blood-brain barrier penetration.
ALZ_BACE1.aether_solution: BACE1/BACE2 selectivity ratio >380-fold with high CNS multiparameter optimization score (MPO = 5.2/6.0).

CML_ABL1_T315I.india_epidemiology: CML is the most common adult leukemia in India, presenting at median age 38-40 (a decade younger than West).
CML_ABL1_T315I.resistance_mechanism: T315I bulky isoleucine substitution sterically blocks imatinib, dasatinib, and nilotinib.
CML_ABL1_T315I.aether_solution: Linear carbon-carbon triple bond linker bypassing the steric obstruction of Ile315 with dual ATP/allosteric pocket occupancy.

NEURO_ACHE.india_epidemiology: Critical symptomatic treatment for progressive dementia and neuromuscular junction disorders.
NEURO_ACHE.resistance_mechanism: Dose-limiting peripheral cholinergic adverse effects and lack of disease-modifying neuroprotection.
NEURO_ACHE.aether_solution: Dual catalytic-site (CAS) and peripheral anionic site (PAS) inhibitor inhibiting both acetylcholine hydrolysis and Abeta aggregation.

AUTO_JAK3.india_epidemiology: High prevalence of autoimmune rheumatoid arthritis in Indian women (~0.75% of adult population).
AUTO_JAK3.global_epidemiology: >18 million people live with rheumatoid arthritis worldwide.
AUTO_JAK3.resistance_mechanism: Lack of isoform selectivity between JAK1, JAK2, and JAK3, leading to anemia, lipid elevation, and infection risks.
AUTO_JAK3.aether_solution: Covalent inhibitor targeting the non-conserved Cys909 residue present in JAK3 but absent in JAK1/2/TYK2, achieving >250-fold isoform selectivity.

ONC_CDK2.disease_indication: CDK4/6 Inhibitor Resistant Breast Cancer & Ovarian Cancer
ONC_CDK2.india_epidemiology: Breast cancer is the #1 cancer among Indian females (13.5% of all cancer cases in India).
ONC_CDK2.global_epidemiology: 2.3 million women diagnosed with breast cancer annually.
ONC_CDK2.standard_of_care_drug: Palbociclib/Ribociclib (CDK4/6 inhibitors; resistance develops via CCNE1/CDK2 amplification)
ONC_CDK2.resistance_mechanism: Cyclin E1/E2 amplification bypasses CDK4/6 blockade, restoring Rb phosphorylation and driving tumor progression.
ONC_CDK2.aether_solution: Potent CDK2-selective inhibitor sparing CDK1 (preventing bone marrow suppression) to overcome palbociclib resistance.
